verification_steps.command:
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
r=subprocess.run(['"'"'make'"'"','"'"'check'"'"'],capture_output=True,text=True)
sys.stdout.write(r.stdout);sys.stderr.write(r.stderr)
assert r.returncode==0, '"'"'作者完整make check未通过'"'"'
expected={**{f'"'"'examples/c/example{i}.trs'"'"':'"'"'PASS'"'"' for i in range(1,5)},**{f'"'"'examples/c++/example{i}.trs'"'"':('"'"'XFAIL'"'"' if i==4 else '"'"'PASS'"'"') for i in range(1,5)},'"'"'tests/libconfig_tests.trs'"'"':'"'"'PASS'"'"'}
actual={str(p):next(line.split('"'"':'"'"',2)[2].strip() for line in p.read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('"'"':test-result:'"'"')) for p in Path('"'"'.'"'"').rglob('"'"'*.trs'"'"')}
assert actual==expected, repr(actual)
print('"'"'FORGE_AUTHOR_TESTS_VERIFIED=8PASS+1XFAIL'"'"')
' && python3 -c 'import hashlib,json,subprocess
rows=subprocess.run(['"'"'git'"'"','"'"'ls-files'"'"','"'"'-z'"'"'],check=True,capture_output=True).stdout.decode().split('"'"'\0'"'"')
assert rows[-1]=='"'"''"'"', '"'"'Git索引输出不完整'"'"'
names=rows[:-1]
actual=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted(names),ensure_ascii=True,separators=('"'"','"'"','"'"':'"'"')).encode()).hexdigest()
assert actual=='"'"'bac2a32099aa71d7d23f9b0558eb8ab2d8eb4d2c81c29389a5b1f0500b1773b8'"'"', '"'"'Git索引文件集合与固定原源码不同'"'"'
assert subprocess.run(['"'"'git'"'"','"'"'rev-parse'"'"','"'"'--verify'"'"','"'"'HEAD'"'"'],capture_output=True).returncode!=0, '"'"'不允许伪造源码commit'"'"'
print('"'"'FORGE_SOURCE_INDEX_VERIFIED='"'"'+actual)
'
